queries.name: item_in_use_duration

queries.hover:

Empty hand or no use time: 0. Armor stands count like mobs; a pillager reads 0 until it starts charging.

queries.name: item_is_charged
queries.summary: Whether the item in a hand holds a charged projectile (loaded crossbow)
queries.hover:

Hand: omitted/0/'main_hand' = main hand, 1/'off_hand' = off hand. Numbers are truncated (0.9 -> 0, 1.5 -> 1).
Negative numbers, 2 or more, and other strings log an error and return 0 (Windows).
queries.description: Returns 1 when the item in the chosen hand has a projectile loaded into it - a charged crossbow - and 0 otherwise. With no argument the main hand is checked.

args.name: hand
args.description: Which hand to check
accepts: number; truncated toward zero: 0 = main hand, 1 = off hand (negative: error on Windows)

queries.name: item_max_use_duration

queries.description: Returns the full use time of the item in the main hand - how long a bow can be drawn, how long a crossbow takes to charge - in ticks multiplied by 20. Returns 0 for items without a use time.

A slot name alone returns ticks x 20, not seconds. Players only; other entities 0.
queries.description: Reports how much of the current item use is left. With no argument the result is in seconds; with a normalization value it is the remaining fraction of the item's use time, times that value.

args.name: slot
args.description: Hand whose item is checked; also allowed as the only argument
